authorized_scope: Audit observable inputs/labels, score mask, sequence reset, test-time feature-only adaptation boundaries, TL3 ancestry status and source-qualified fold assets; no model/native execution, fitting or full dataset scan.

official_docs_verified.verifier: root agent reported current official docs check

observable_contract.sequence_order: Rows arrive in given order; seq_ix changes identify independent sequences.
observable_contract.allowed_temporal_information: current row and earlier rows of the same sequence only
observable_contract.test_scoring_mask: hidden; platform applies it after inference; predict every required row

data_semantics_and_provenance.labels: t0/t1 are anonymous future-movement indicators for i0; exact target definition is undisclosed.
data_semantics_and_provenance.features: 112 documented channels for anonymous i0/i1 plus a0-a7; category names do not prove venue or market semantics.

online_adaptation.official_rule_status: No explicit ban or permission located for test-time learning. Current official rules prohibit external data; callback contract permits only causal same-sequence feature observations.
online_adaptation.conservative_admissible_interpretation: Deterministic per-sequence RLS/fast-weight or feature-statistics inference state updated from current/past inputs only, with full reset at sequence boundary and no labels or scoring mask.
online_adaptation.not_authorized_by_this_audit: Do not infer blanket permission for global neural fine-tuning or use test labels/mask. Such implementation/rule questions require separate explicit basis.
online_adaptation.first_candidate: Frozen model plus a predeclared deterministic per-sequence feature-state update; test later-sequence behavior with evaluator-only labels and fixed position bins.

f0_reference.exposure: Previously exposed and adaptively selected F0; valid matched comparison panel, not fresh holdout.
f0_reference.teacher_membership: T3 metadata binds seeds 3/4/5 epoch 2 to the same fold0 fit membership.

f2_f3_packet.status: Prepared, not admitted/fitted; F2/F3 evaluation components previously inspected. Crossfold robustness only.

cleanfold_assets.prior_exposure: All four main folds are exposed or potentially exposed; different seeds do not create a fresh holdout.

tl3.actual_training_teacher_initializer_memb: UNKNOWN pending actual source/metadata ancestry audit.
tl3.cleanfold_use: Not a cleanfold reference/teacher until ancestry is verified; team asset reuse remains authorized for exploratory use.

invalid_claims: test-time supervised update from t0/t1 or is_scored
future-row lookahead or cross-sequence adaptation state
seq_ix as feature or temporal order
a clean-holdout claim from TL3 or an all-data endpoint without full ancestry
a pristine holdout claim from any already exposed/potentially exposed main fold
venue, exchange timestamp, corporate-action or adjustment claims inferred from anonymous columns

evidence.supports: sequence shape, warmup, causal rule, callback observability, labels, hidden scoring mask and metric
external-data prohibition and public pretrained-source allowance
static callback example processes current feature state and updates recurrent state before warmup return
official metric identifier, clip and pooled global score
source-qualified manifest identities and evaluated-component exclusion
F0 source-qualified T3 teacher memberships matching fold0 fit groups
F0 checkpoint, fold0 split, initializer, training/evaluation mode
F0 evaluation size, exposure and exact checkpoint identity
TL3 archive hash, imported member inventory and unknown ancestry
F2/F3 manifests/preparation status, past evaluation exposure and no fit claim
source-qualified score requirements and exposed panel limits
all four folds exposed/potentially exposed and current F0 status
